knowledge_area.name: Lithium-Ion Battery Failure Intelligence
knowledge_area.description: An evidence-backed specialist system covering lithium-ion cell and system failure: failure mechanisms, thermal runaway initiation and propagation, vent-gas composition, early detection, suppression and cooling, battery energy storage and electric-vehicle incident precedent, and the transport, storage, installation and waste rules that govern them. Every answer is traceable to a stored source with a URI, publisher and retrieval date, and is machine-checked for unsupported claims before it is returned.

declared: The full texts of NFPA 855, UL 9540A, IEC 62619, UN 38.3 and UNECE R100 are copyrighted and are NOT stored. They are registered as pointers only: the system can tell you a standard exists and is relevant, and cite secondary sources that describe it, but it cannot quote its clauses.

Thermal-runaway onset temperatures, vent-gas composition and propagation behaviour vary substantially with cell chemistry, format, state of charge and ageing. Any single figure should be read as specific to the test conditions of the source that reports it.
Academic coverage is drawn from open-access preprints. It is neither a systematic review nor peer-reviewed at the point of ingestion, and recent preprints may be superseded.
Coverage is strongest for UK and EU regulation and weakest for US state fire codes, Chinese GB standards and Japanese regulation.

Encyclopaedia sources (authority 2) are included for coverage and vocabulary. They are deliberately outranked by regulators and investigation bodies, but they are still cited where nothing better exists.
